batch_before.label_limits: Sparse label groups are observations only; counterfactual-records.json holds name fixed across changed ranks and changes name across an unchanged matrix, with native grading checked. Choice position and label are not used in rank construction.
batch_before.baseline: 1/5 for a uniform random choice. Exact proposed batch rejects every tested strategy within each recognizable workload and active-row group. Controls are a union of independent two-item batches, boundary and counterfactual witnesses; chance coincidences in tiny subgroups are reported as fractions, not presented as evidence of a sampler rule or an actual delivered batch. Rank contrast is required for every structural control group.
